text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since entering the waiting room, Red 
Desire has been praying non-stop.
I wonder 
if she's praying to the heavens for 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! Thank you for letting me 
know.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: No? There's no need for that.
choice_data_list: Were you praying for a win?
Were you praying for a win?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Since my last defeat, I have devised 
strategies with Trainer-san and undergone 
rigorous training. Today, I have no blind 
spots."
choice_data_list: So what were you praying for?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I only prayed…… that everyone could
finish 
the race safely……
choice_data_list: So, what were you praying for?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because that is the duty of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Red Desire look so composed,
I send 
her off to the race with peace of mind.
